posts.title: Editing text inside a PDF: what actually changes (and what doesn't)
posts.desc: A PDF is a page description, not a paragraph. Here is what happens when you retype a line in a PDF editor, and the cases where a clean edit is not possible.

posts.title: Black boxes aren't redaction: how redacted PDFs still leak
posts.desc: Drawing a rectangle over a name does not remove it. Here is where hidden text, metadata and stale revisions hide in a PDF — and how to check your own file before you send it.

posts.title: Why your PDF is 40 MB — and what compression actually removes
posts.desc: A PDF's size is almost never the words. It is the images, the fonts and the way the file was saved. Here is how to shrink one without turning your document into a photo.

posts.title: Merging PDFs: page order, mixed page sizes, and what quietly gets lost
posts.desc: Combining files looks trivial and usually is — until bookmarks, form fields or a password get in the way. What a merge keeps, what it drops, and how to check the result.

posts.title: JPG to PDF: page size, DPI, and why your scans look soft
posts.desc: Converting photos to PDF is easy; making the result printable, legible and correctly sized is arithmetic. Here is the maths that decides whether a page looks sharp.

posts.title: What actually makes an electronic signature valid?
posts.desc: A drawn signature on a PDF is a picture. Whether it binds anyone depends on intent, consent, attribution and the record around it. A plain-English guide.

posts.title: A4 vs Letter: why your PDF prints with white edges
posts.desc: Page size, margins and the difference between cropping and scaling — the measurements behind the white border on your printout, explained in points and inches.
